item.title: Benton cancels August Third Thursday event due to extreme heat forecast
item.dc:creator: Shelli Poole
item.description: Organizers of Downtown Benton’s Third Thursday have announced the cancellation of their upcoming August 20, 2026, event due to a prolonged forecast of intense heat. With triple-digit temperatures and dangerous heat indexes expected over the next ten-plus days, officials stated the difficult decision was made to ensure the safety of the community. Read more […]
item.content:encoded:
Organizers of Downtown Benton’s Third Thursday have announced the cancellation of their upcoming August 20, 2026, event due to a prolonged forecast of intense heat. With triple-digit temperatures and dangerous heat indexes expected over the next ten-plus days, officials stated the difficult decision was made to ensure the safety of the community. Read more below.




In a public statement, event organizers explained that keeping vendors, food truck operators, musical bands, and local citizens safe is their top priority. The excessive temperatures and high heat indexes made canceling the outdoor summer celebration a necessary precaution to prevent heat-related illnesses among attendees and workers.

While the August festivities are canceled, the popular downtown festival will resume next month. Organizers confirmed the community gathering will return in September for its scheduled “Faith and Family” night, and they urge everyone to stay safe and cool in the meantime.

We are just a few weeks away from the closing of our Fall Ball Programs. If you and your family are looking for a great opportunity to enjoy the ball fields soon, please make sure to check the list below:
Blastball (Ages 3-5) CLICK HERE – Blastball is a pre-tee ball program designed for boys and girls to learn the very foundation of softball and baseball play. It is also a great way to provide them that first social experience of what it means to be on a team.
***
Miracle League (Ages 3 to Adults) CLICK HERE – FREE! Miracle League is a baseball league serving children and adults living with physical or mental disabilities. Miracle League is about making friends, building self-esteem, and being treated like other athletes. The Buddy System is used for those who may have the need assistance!
WE NEED BUDDIES!!! Miracle League serves such an important part of our community, and we would love for you to be a part of it! We are looking for individuals, ball teams, Church groups, etc. who would love to spend an afternoon with our league. If interested, please email Daniel Torchinsky at daniel.torchinsky@bentonar.org.

Youth Softball (Ages 4-16) CLICK HERE – Fall Youth Softball is a shortened 4-week season designed to help your child tune up and/or learn the game! We take team registrations and free agents of all age divisions from Instructional League (Tee Ball) through 16U. There are no standings or scores recorded, which allows this league to help girls and coaches learn the game and their age division-specific rules leading up to the big Spring Season!
***
Baseball – Benton Parks & Recreation does not operate the boys baseball league. This is operated through the Benton Youth Sports Association, also known as the BYSA.
